episode_title: Toppforvaltarens strategi i en multipolar varld

recommendations.speaker: Morten Springborg
recommendations.reasoning: Svenska forsvarsbolag med cirka 50% av forsaljningen fran svenska regeringen. Sveriges statsfinanser ar robusta vilket ger stabilitet at ordern. Sverige forvants uppna NATO-malen till skillnad fran Sydeuropa. Europeisk forsvarssektor maste expandera kraftigt och Saab ar valpositionerat.
recommendations.quote: Sweden is probably okay, Saab is probably okay. Saab, I believe, is getting close to 50% of its sales from the Swedish government. And the Swedish public finances are pretty robust.
recommendations.position_context: C Worldwide har overvikt i kvalitetskapitalvarubolag

recommendations.speaker: Morten Springborg
recommendations.reasoning: Tysk forsvarsforetag med stod av robusta tyska statsfinanser. Tyskland forvantnas uppna NATO-malen. Europeisk forsvarssektor maste expandera for att mota geopolitiska hot.
recommendations.quote: Same thing goes for Germany. Rheinmetall is pretty okay.

recommendations.speaker: Morten Springborg
recommendations.reasoning: Italienskt forsvarsbolag men italienska statsfinanserna ar fragila. Sydeuropa forvantnas inte kunna uppna NATO-malen vilket skapar osaker orderingaing.
recommendations.quote: But when you get to Italy and Leonardo, question mark. [...] I can easily see that defense spending is going to go up in Europe, but it's not going to go up in equal amounts. Like France, for example, will not be able to meet its NATO targets.

recommendations.speaker: Morten Springborg
recommendations.reasoning: Europa ar rikt utrustat med hogkvalitativa kapitalvarubolag som ar kritiska for aterindustrialisering. Sverige, Tyskland, Finland, Italien och Frankrike har excellenta bolag inom kapitalvaror och teknik. Massiv investeringsvag kommer i Vastvarlden for att ateruppbygga tillverkningskapacitet.
recommendations.quote: For us, that means that we have a significant over weight in quality capital goods companies that we believe are critical for the rebuilding of manufacturing systems in the West that we lost over the last few decades. And the good thing is that Europe is so richly endowed with high quality capital goods companies. Sweden is one center for this excellence.

recommendations.speaker: Morten Springborg
recommendations.reasoning: Elektrifiering ar ett stort tema med stora investeringsmojligheter. Vakten av elkonsumtion skapar mojligheter for bolag inom energisektorn. Europa och USA maste elektrifieras for att vara konkurrenskraftiga.
recommendations.quote: We like the theme of electrification, which is also something that we have a strong presence in Europe. [...] there are big, big investment opportunities in everything related to growing electricity consumption.
recommendations.position_context: C Worldwide har stark narvaro i temat

recommendations.speaker: Morten Springborg
recommendations.reasoning: Centralbankerna i Global South och Kina bygger guldreserver for att kunna delta i ett nytt monetart system dar guld ar den neutrala reservtillgangen. Overgang fran unipolar dollarvarlden till multipolar valutavarlden driver efterfragan.
recommendations.quote: And that explains also why gold has been going up as it is, because global central banks are building gold reserves in order to be able to participate in a new monetary system where gold is the neutral reserve asset.

recommendations.speaker: Morten Springborg
recommendations.reasoning: USA utgjorde 70% av globala aktiemarknader 2025 - en bubbla som kommer att normaliseras. US-dollarn ar overvarderap och behover falla. Historiskt normal vikt for USA ar runt 50%. C Worldwide ar markant underviktade i USA.
recommendations.quote: I think that when we look back in 5 to 10 years' time, that will be shown to have been a bubble. It will come down, amongst other things, because I think that the US dollar is very, very expensive and needs to come down.
recommendations.downside_note: 70% av globala aktiemarknader ar historiskt extremt

recommendations.speaker: Morten Springborg
recommendations.reasoning: Sydostasiens valutablock kommer att stiga signifikant de nasta 5-20 aren. Tillgangsvarderingar i regionen kommer att ta en mycket storre del av globala tillgangsvarden. C Worldwide gillar strukturellt emerging markets.
recommendations.quote: And we like emerging markets structurally. [...] the whole currency area of Southeast Asia is going to rise significantly over the next 5 to 10 to 20 years. And with it, the asset values in that part of the region will take up a much, much bigger part of global asset values.

recommendations.speaker: Morten Springborg
recommendations.reasoning: C Worldwide har lanserat en internationell strategi (global ex-US) som de tror ar ratt plats for langsiktiga investerare de nasta 10 aren. Institutionella investerare i USA vill diversifiera bort fran overexponering mot inhemsk marknad.
recommendations.quote: And therefore, we have recently actually also launched an international strategy which is basically global ex-US, which we think is the place to be the next 10 years for the long-term investor.
recommendations.catalyst_timing: Normalisering av US-vikt i globala index

stock_segments.discussion_summary: Djupgaende diskussion om europeisk forsvarssektor. Marknaden ar fragmenterad med manga nationella spelare (Saab, Kongsberg, Rheinmetall, Leonardo). Forsaljningen ar beroende av inhemska regeringars budgetallokering. Svenska och tyska statsfinanser ar robusta medan Sydeuropa ar fragilt. Ryssland tillverkar 4 ganger mer militar utrustning an Europa. Konsolidering behovs men politiskt svar att genomfora med 27 lander.

insights.quote: I think 2025 will be remembered by the historians as a year as important as probably 1989, when the Berlin Wall fell.
insights.summary: 2025 markerar overgangen fran unipolar till multipolar varldsordning, lika historiskt betydelsefullt som Berlinmurens fall.
insights.speaker: Morten Springborg

insights.quote: China has for the last, I would say almost 40 years, at least since early 1990s, prepared for this event to happen. That eventually China with a population of 1.4 billion people would have an economic strength that would rival the American.
insights.summary: Kinas ekonomiska uppgang ar resultatet av 40 ars systematisk forberedelse for att rivalisera USA ekonomiskt.
insights.speaker: Morten Springborg

insights.quote: We need to invest something like 20 times the amount of capital in renewables, compared to a gas-powered power plant, for example, in order to get the same amount of energy out of it, because of the low density of renewables.
insights.summary: Fornybar energi kraver 20 ganger mer kapital an gas for samma energiutfall pa grund av lag energitathet.
insights.speaker: Morten Springborg

insights.quote: Sweden has a record, a world record, in the most electricity capacity additions per capita in the world, which happened between 1971 and 1986.
insights.summary: Sverige har varldsrekord i elkapacitetsutbyggnad per capita 1971-1986 genom karnkraft - bevisar att snabb omstallning ar mojlig.
insights.speaker: Morten Springborg

insights.quote: In the US the focus on generative AI is this pursuit of superintelligence... While in China, they have a much more practical approach to AI, where they focus very much on applications that can generate some kind of immediate payoff.
insights.summary: USA jagar superintelligens medan Kina fokuserar pa praktiska AI-tillampningar med omedelbar avkastning - tva fundamentalt olika strategier.
insights.speaker: Morten Springborg

insights.quote: The US equity market peaked at 70% of global equities last year. I think that when we look back in 5 to 10 years' time, that will be shown to have been a bubble.
insights.summary: USA:s 70% andel av globala aktiemarknader ar en bubbla som kommer att normaliseras mot historiska 50%.
insights.speaker: Morten Springborg

insights.quote: We are moving away from a unipolar world to a multipolar world. That means also the operating system of our economy will have to transition to a new monetary system that is not based on the unipolar world, namely the dollar, but into a multipolar currency world.
insights.summary: Det globala monetara systemet kommer att overga fran dollarbaserat till multipolart med guld som neutral reservtillgang.
insights.speaker: Morten Springborg

insights.quote: In order to avoid war, you have to prepare for war. And we have not prepared for war, and we are very, very weak.
insights.summary: Europa ar extremt sarbart pa grund av bristande forberedelse - klassisk romersk visdom om krigsforberedelse ar relevant.
insights.speaker: Morten Springborg

market_sentiment_reasoning: Positiv syn pa Europa och tillvaxtmarknader pa grund av massiva investeringsbehov i forsvar, tillverkning och elektrifiering. Negativ syn pa USA som ar overvarderap. Orolig for geopolitiska spannningar men ser stora investeringsmojligheter i omstallningen.
summary: Avsnittet ar en djupgaende intervju med Morten Springborg fran C Worldwide om den geopolitiska omvandlingen fran unipolar till multipolar varldsordning. Han betonar att 2025 markerar en historisk vandpunkt nar Kina vaxte fram som ekonomisk supermakt. Europa ar sarbart med energiberoende (58% import) och utlokaliserad tillverkning. Forsvarsuppbyggnad ar nodvandig men begransas av fragmenterad marknad och svaga statsfinanser i Sydeuropa. Springborg ar optimistisk for europeiska kapitalvarubolag, forsvarsaktier (sarskilt Saab och Rheinmetall), elektrifiering och emerging markets. Han avradar fran amerikanska aktier som han ser som overvarderap vid 70% av globala marknaden.
